Consider the following two statements, labeled Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Evaluate them and choose the appropriate answer from the given options.

Assertion (A): The standard distance between the penalty spot and the goal line on a football field is 11 meters.

Reason (R): This distance allows the goalkeeper a fair reaction time while challenging the accuracy and confidence of the penalty taker.

options.text: A is false, but R is true.
A is true, but R is false.
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The penalty spot in football is positioned **11 meters (12 yards)** from the goal line as per the Laws of the Game set by FIFA.
 
• This distance was formalized in 1891 when the penalty kick rule was introduced to ensure fairness and maintain a balance between the penalty taker and the goalkeeper.
 
• The reasoning behind the distance is to provide the goalkeeper with a fair reaction time while simultaneously challenging the accuracy and confidence of the penalty taker.
 
• The penalty kick is a direct free kick, and only the penalty taker and the goalkeeper are allowed to be in the penalty area during the kick.
 
• The goalkeeper must remain on the goal line until the penalty is taken but may move laterally to prepare for the shot.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Penalty Kick Overview:**

 
 
• Introduced in 1891 as a measure to prevent intentional fouls near the goal.
 
• A penalty kick is awarded when a player commits a direct free kick offense inside their own penalty area.
 
• The penalty spot is a fixed point from which the penalty taker must shoot the ball.
 
 
 
• **FIFA Laws of the Game:**
 
 
• The Laws of the Game are maintained by the International Football Association Board (IFAB), with FIFA as a key member.
 
• These laws dictate the dimensions and markings on the football field, including the penalty area and spot.
 
 
 
• **Goalkeeper Rules During a Penalty:**
 
 
• The goalkeeper must have at least part of one foot touching, or in line with, the goal line until the ball is kicked.
 
• Moving forward off the goal line before the penalty is taken results in a retake if a goal is not scored.
 
 
 
• **Psychological Aspects of Penalty Kicks:**
 
 
• Penalty kicks test the mental focus and composure of both the penalty taker and the goalkeeper.
 
• Studies show that penalty shootouts are often influenced by psychological pressure and confidence.
 
 
 
• **Historical Context:**
 
 
• The penalty kick was first used in a competitive match in 1891 during an Irish Cup semi-final.
 
• It has since become a crucial part of football, used to resolve matches tied after extra time in knockout tournaments.

Which of the following accurately describes The Seven Moons of Maali Almeida, winner of the 2022 Booker Prize?

1.The novel is set during the civil war in Sri Lanka and explores the afterlife of a photojournalist.

2.It is a non-fictional account of archaeological excavations in the Gandhara region.

3. The author, Shehan Karunatilaka, uses satire and ghosts to comment on violence, memory, and political trauma.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2: 1 and 3 only**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **The Seven Moons of Maali Almeida** is a novel by Sri Lankan author Shehan Karunatilaka, which won the **2022 Booker Prize**.
 
• The novel is set against the backdrop of the **Sri Lankan Civil War** and follows the story of a deceased photojournalist navigating the afterlife to uncover the truth behind his death.
 
• Shehan Karunatilaka uses **satire, humor, and supernatural elements**, including ghosts, to explore themes such as violence, memory, and political trauma.
 
• The narrative critiques the **political and social turmoil in Sri Lanka**, highlighting the struggles of individuals caught in the conflict.
 
• Option 1 (civil war and afterlife) and Option 3 (satire and political commentary) are accurate descriptions of the book, while Option 2 (archaeological excavations) is unrelated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Booker Prize:**

 
 
• One of the most prestigious literary awards in the world, it recognizes the best novel written in English and published in the UK or Ireland.
 
• Established in 1969, it celebrates outstanding literary works that contribute to global literature.
 
 
 
• **Sri Lankan Civil War:**
 
 
• A 26-year-long conflict (1983–2009) between the Sri Lankan government and the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE), seeking an independent Tamil state.
 
• The war caused immense suffering, loss of life, and displacement, heavily influencing Sri Lankan art and literature.
 
 
 
• **Shehan Karunatilaka:**
 
 
• An acclaimed Sri Lankan author whose works often explore themes of history, politics, and identity.
 
• His debut novel, "Chinaman: The Legend of Pradeep Mathew," won several awards, including the Commonwealth Book Prize.
 
 
 
• **Supernatural Elements in Literature:**
 
 
• Ghosts, spirits, and the afterlife are often used to address unresolved conflicts, memories, and traumas.
 
• In "The Seven Moons of Maali Almeida," the supernatural serves as a narrative tool to explore both personal and societal issues.

In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

An astronaut must train before going to space.

P. They use a simulator to practice.

Q. Their body must get used to zero gravity.

R. They learn emergency procedures.

S. They also learn how to wear the space suit.

All this helps them prepare well.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage begins with the need for an astronaut to train before going to space.
 
• **Sentence Q comes first** as it mentions the physical adaptation required for zero gravity:
 
 
• "Their body must get used to zero gravity."
 
 
 
• **Sentence S follows** as it introduces the training on wearing a space suit:
 
 
• "They also learn how to wear the space suit."
 
 
 
• **Sentence P comes next** as it describes the use of a simulator for practice:
 
 
• "They use a simulator to practice."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R concludes** as it mentions learning emergency procedures:
 
 
• "They learn emergency procedures."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **QSPR**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"An astronaut must train before going to space. Their body must get used to zero gravity. They also learn how to wear the space suit. They use a simulator to practice. They learn emergency procedures. All this helps them prepare well."

questions.solution:

__

• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"I must go now" becomes "she had to go then"**
 
 
• The modal verb "must" is changed to "had to" to match indirect speech.
 
• The adverb "now" is changed to "then" to reflect the time shift in indirect speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Indirect speech removes quotation marks and adjusts pronouns, verbs, and time expressions.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She said that she had to go then."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The verb "was going" implies a continuous action, which is not the correct conversion for "must go."
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "She said that she must go now."
 
 
• The modal verb "must" remains unchanged, which is incorrect in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "She said that she will go now."
 
 
• The modal verb "will" is incorrect as it changes the intended meaning of the original sentence.
